name: Satchmo Holdings Limited
about: Satchmo Holdings Limited engages in the business of real estate development in India. It operates through Investment and Trading in Equities; Service Business of Facilities/Manpower/Catering/Restaurants Activities; and Others segments. The company offers meat and poultry food, dairy products, fruits and vegetables, and ready-to-eat packaged food. It is also involved in the business of restaurants, including quick service restaurants, cloud kitchens, casual dining, and express kiosks; and equity trading activities. In addition, the company provides transportation, sports, corporate, and event catering services; and facilities management services, including integrated services comprising safety and security of the premises, and housekeeping mechanical, electrical & plumbing, maintenance, and landscaping for residential, commercial, and government establishments. The company was formerly known as NEL Holdings South Limited and changed its name to Satchmo Holdings Limited in December 2022. Satchmo Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.
